title: ACDC SMP QoL ModPack
description: This mod-Pack is the official mod-pack of the ACDC SMP! It contains a lot of Quality of Life Mods and performance improvements for vanilla Minecraft. This mod-pack does not impact any gameplay aspects and is made to work on vanilla Minecraft servers.
body:
# The ACDC QoL Modpack 

This is the official mod-pack of the ACDC SMP. This modpack gives Performance Enhancements and Quality of Life Mods, Resource Packs and Shaders that enhance the SMP

No Content within this pack affects gameplay of vanilla and is purely Quality of Life.

# To join our server please join our discord and Apply!
